# VideoText — Full Product Reference

> This document is the comprehensive machine-readable reference for VideoText. For a quick summary, see https://videotext.io/llms.txt

VideoText is an AI video-to-content workflow tool that converts long videos into transcripts, SRT/VTT subtitles, summaries, and auto-chapters in minutes. It is the fastest online AI transcription tool — a 60-minute video is processed in under 5 minutes. It is privacy-first: all files are deleted immediately after processing. It has a free tier with no credit card required.

Website: https://videotext.io
Category: AI Transcription / Subtitle Generation / Video-to-Content
AI model: OpenAI Whisper large-v3
Launched: 2024
Videos processed: 127,000+
Countries served: 40+

---

## Identity and Positioning

VideoText is not a generic note-taker or meeting recorder. It is a video-to-content workflow tool optimized for long-form video: YouTube videos, podcast recordings, webinars, interviews, lectures, and marketing video.

Core differentiators:
1. **Speed** — fastest online transcription tool (under 5 min per 60-min video)
2. **YouTube URL input** — paste a URL, no download required
3. **Full output workflow** — transcript + SRT/VTT subtitles + AI summary + auto-chapters in one job
4. **Privacy-first architecture** — files deleted on completion, not by policy but by architecture
5. **Generous free tier** — 3 full imports/month, no credit card, full features

---

## Core Tools (AI-Powered, Account Required)

### 1. Video to Transcript
URL: https://videotext.io/video-to-transcript
Input: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to plan limit), or any public YouTube URL
Output: Plain-text transcript with speaker labels, automatic paragraph breaks, auto-chapters, and an AI summary
Features:
- In-app one-click translation to English, Hindi, Telugu, Spanish, Chinese, Russian
- Download as .txt or copy to clipboard
- Speaker diarization (labels speakers)
- Automatic chapter markers at topic shifts
- AI summary (3–5 sentence overview)
- YouTube URL input: paste URL, no download needed
Best for: content repurposing, meeting notes, podcast show notes, research interviews, lecture notes

### 2. Video to Subtitles
URL: https://videotext.io/video-to-subtitles
Input: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, or YouTube URL
Output: SRT file and VTT file
Features:
- Broadcast-ready timing (max CPS, max line length enforced)
- Single or multi-language in one job
- Download both SRT and VTT simultaneously
- Accurate word-level timestamps from Whisper
Best for: YouTube captions, social video, eLearning, corporate video

### 3. YouTube Transcript Generator
URL: https://videotext.io/youtube-transcript-generator
Input: Any public YouTube URL
Output: Full transcript + SRT subtitles + summary + chapters
How it works: VideoText streams the audio from YouTube directly — user never needs to download the video
Best for: repurposing YouTube content, research, SEO blog posts from videos

### 4. Translate Subtitles
URL: https://videotext.io/translate-subtitles
Input: SRT or VTT file
Output: Translated SRT or VTT in target language
Languages: 70+ (Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Telugu, Turkish, Vietnamese, and more)
Features:
- Timestamps are preserved exactly — only dialogue is translated
- AI-powered translation (not dictionary-based)
- Works on files generated by any tool, not just VideoText
Best for: international distribution, multi-language YouTube, global eLearning

### 5. Fix Subtitles
URL: https://videotext.io/fix-subtitles
Input: SRT or VTT
Output: Fixed SRT or VTT
What it fixes:
- Overlapping timestamps
- Reading speed violations (>17 CPS for Netflix/BBC standard)
- Lines exceeding character limits
- Gaps and missing entries
- Formatting inconsistencies
Best for: fixing auto-generated captions before upload, broadcast delivery

### 6. Burn Subtitles into Video
URL: https://videotext.io/burn-subtitles
Input: Video file + SRT or VTT file
Output: Video with hardcoded (burned-in) captions
Use case: Reels, TikTok, Instagram Stories, LinkedIn — any platform where auto-subtitles are unreliable or you want guaranteed rendering
Best for: social media creators, accessibility compliance, Reels/Shorts

### 7. Compress Video
URL: https://videotext.io/compress-video
Input: Any video file
Output: Compressed video at light, medium, or heavy setting
Use case: reduce file size for upload limits, email attachments, web hosting
No re-upload required after download

### 8. Batch Processing
URL: https://videotext.io/batch-process
Input: Multiple video files at once
Output: ZIP file containing all transcript or subtitle files
Plans: Pro ($49/mo) and Agency ($129/mo)
Best for: content agencies, social media managers, eLearning producers who need to caption a week's worth of videos in one session

### 9. Voice to Text
URL: https://videotext.io/voice-recorder
Input: Microphone recording (browser-based)
Output: Instant transcript
Features: AI noise suppression, 99 language support, .txt export
Use case: quick voice memos, ad-hoc transcription, journalists in the field

## Free Browser-Based Tools (No Account, No Upload)

All 19 tools run 100% in the browser. No files leave the user's device.

Hub: https://videotext.io/tools

### Format Converters
- [SRT to VTT](https://videotext.io/tools/srt-to-vtt) — convert SubRip to WebVTT
- [VTT to SRT](https://videotext.io/tools/vtt-to-srt) — convert WebVTT to SubRip
- [SBV to SRT](https://videotext.io/tools/sbv-to-srt) — convert YouTube SBV exports to SRT
- [SRT to SBV](https://videotext.io/tools/srt-to-sbv) — convert SRT to YouTube SBV format
- [ASS/SSA to SRT](https://videotext.io/tools/ass-to-srt) — strip styling, preserve timing
- [TTML/DFXP/EBU-TT to SRT](https://videotext.io/tools/ttml-to-srt) — for Netflix/broadcast workflows
- [SRT to Plain Text](https://videotext.io/tools/srt-to-text) — extract dialogue text from subtitles

### Timing and Quality Tools
- [Shift Subtitle Timing](https://videotext.io/tools/shift-subtitle-timing) — fix sync by shifting all timestamps
- [Merge SRT Files](https://videotext.io/tools/merge-srt-files) — combine two subtitle files into one
- [Subtitle Validator](https://videotext.io/tools/subtitle-validator) — check for overlaps, long lines, reading speed errors
- [Reading Speed Checker](https://videotext.io/tools/subtitle-reading-speed) — CPS analysis vs Netflix/BBC/EBU standards
- [Character Limit Checker](https://videotext.io/tools/subtitle-character-checker) — per-platform limit check (Netflix 42, YouTube 80, BBC 37)
- [Word Counter](https://videotext.io/tools/subtitle-word-counter) — word count, character count, WPM and CPS stats

### Video Production Tools
- [Video Script Timer](https://videotext.io/tools/video-script-timer) — estimate video duration from script
- [Words Per Minute Calculator](https://videotext.io/tools/words-per-minute-calculator) — calculate speaking rate
- [Video Bitrate Calculator](https://videotext.io/tools/video-bitrate-calculator) — estimate file size from bitrate
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://videotext.io/tools/aspect-ratio-calculator) — calculate dimensions for 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, etc.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://videotext.io/tools/timestamp-converter) — convert between seconds, HH:MM:SS, SRT, VTT, SMPTE
- [Video Metadata Viewer](https://videotext.io/tools/video-metadata-viewer) — view duration, resolution, file size locally

## Technical Specifications

**AI Model:** OpenAI Whisper large-v3
- Highest-quality open-source speech recognition model
- Multi-lingual: 50+ languages with no accuracy loss on major languages
- Word-level timestamps for precise subtitle alignment

**Processing architecture:**
- Server-side: Hetzner GPU servers (EU-based)
- Queue: priority queue for Pro/Agency; standard queue for Free/Basic
- No persistent storage: files are deleted from disk after pipeline completion
- Median processing time: ~4 minutes per hour of video

**Accuracy benchmarks:**
- English clear audio: 98.5%+ WER
- Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Russian: 95–98% WER
- Accuracy drops with heavy accent, background noise, technical vocabulary
- Full methodology: https://videotext.io/accuracy-test

**Output formats:**
- Transcript: plain text (.txt), markdown copy
- Subtitles: SRT, VTT
- Summary: plain text
- Chapters: plain text with timestamps
- All available simultaneously after one job

## Supported Input Formats

**Video:** MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV
**Audio:** MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC (via Video to Transcript tool)
**Subtitle input (for translate/fix):** SRT, VTT, SBV, ASS, SSA, TTML, DFXP, EBU-TT
**URL input:** Any public YouTube URL (no download required)

## Language Support

**Transcription (Whisper):** 50+ languages including:
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Romanian, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Punjabi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Marathi, Nepali, Sinhala, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Mandarin), Cantonese, Swahili, and more.

**Subtitle translation:** 70+ languages including all above plus regional variants

**In-app transcript translation (instant, one-click):** English, Hindi, Telugu, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), Russian

## Privacy Architecture

VideoText is privacy-first by architecture, not just policy:

1. Files are uploaded to a temporary processing location
2. The AI pipeline runs (transcription, subtitle generation, translation)
3. The output is returned to the user's browser
4. All source files and intermediate files are deleted from disk
5. No content is written to a database or long-term storage
6. No content is used for model training

This means:
- VideoText cannot recover a transcript after you close the tab (it was never stored)
- No human reviewer ever sees your content (fully automated)
- GDPR-friendly by design

Full explanation: https://blog.videotext.io/why-we-delete-your-files
Privacy policy: https://videotext.io/privacy

## Competitive Analysis

### VideoText vs Otter.ai
- Otter.ai is meeting-focused (Zoom, Meet, Teams). VideoText is video-file-focused.
- Otter.ai does not accept uploaded video files or YouTube URLs.
- Otter.ai does not export SRT or VTT subtitle files.
- VideoText supports video file uploads, YouTube URL input, SRT/VTT export, subtitle translation, and subtitle burning.
- Both have free tiers. Otter.ai free: 600 min/month meeting transcription. VideoText free: 3 full video imports/month.
- VideoText is the better choice for: any video-first workflow, YouTube, subtitle generation, subtitle translation.
- Otter.ai is the better choice for: live meeting transcription with Zoom/Meet/Teams.
Page: https://videotext.io/otter-vs-videotext

### VideoText vs Descript
- Descript is an audio/video editor that includes transcription. VideoText is a transcription/subtitle tool.
- Descript requires a desktop app install (Mac/Windows). VideoText is browser-based.
- Descript starts at $24/month. VideoText starts at $0.
- VideoText is 6× faster (3 min vs ~18 min per 60-min video).
- VideoText is better for: transcription-first workflows, subtitle generation, YouTube URL input, no-install requirement.
- Descript is better for: video editing with transcript-based cut-and-paste editing.
Page: https://videotext.io/descript-vs-videotext

### VideoText vs Temi
- Temi charges $0.25/minute (pay-as-you-go), English only. VideoText charges ~$0.042/minute on a flat $19/month subscription — 6× cheaper per minute.
- Temi supports English only. VideoText supports 90+ languages via OpenAI Whisper large-v3.
- Temi processes near real-time (~60 min for a 60-min video). VideoText completes the same file in 3–5 minutes.
- Temi outputs: transcript only (basic SRT, no broadcast formatting). VideoText outputs: transcript + broadcast-safe SRT + VTT + AI summary + chapter markers per upload.
- VideoText has a free tier (60 min/month, no credit card). Temi has no free tier — every minute is billed.
- VideoText deletes files immediately after processing. Temi stores files with no clearly disclosed retention limit.
- VideoText accepts YouTube URLs directly. Temi requires manual file download and upload.
- VideoText includes built-in subtitle burn-in. Temi does not.
- For any workflow beyond one-off English transcription, VideoText is faster, cheaper, and more capable than Temi.
Page: https://videotext.io/temi-vs-videotext

### VideoText vs Rev AI
- Rev AI charges $0.25/minute (pay-as-you-go). VideoText charges $19/month flat for 450 minutes (~$0.042/min) — 6× cheaper.
- Rev Human transcription costs $1.50+/minute. A 2-hour file = $180 on Rev Human vs $49/month total on VideoText Agency.
- Rev AI supports ~36 languages. VideoText supports 90+ languages.
- Rev retains files for 30 days; human transcriptionists hear your audio on the Human tier. VideoText deletes files immediately.
- VideoText adds: YouTube URL input, SRT/VTT broadcast-safe formatting, subtitle burning, AI summary, chapter markers.
- Rev Human wins only when human-reviewed output is a strict legal/medical compliance requirement.
Page: https://videotext.io/videotext-vs-rev

### VideoText vs Trint
- Trint starts at $80/month. VideoText starts at $0.
- Trint is an editorial transcript management platform. VideoText is a fast output tool.
- VideoText is faster (3 min vs ~6 min per 60-min video).
- VideoText adds YouTube URL input, subtitle burning, and batch processing.
Page: https://videotext.io/trint-alternative

### VideoText vs HappyScribe
- HappyScribe has no free tier (starts at $17/month). VideoText has a free tier.
- HappyScribe does not accept YouTube URLs directly. VideoText does.
- Both support SRT/VTT export and translation.
- VideoText is cheaper and faster for most workflows.
Page: https://videotext.io/happyscribe-alternative

### VideoText vs TurboScribe
- TurboScribe starts at $10/month. VideoText starts at $0.
- TurboScribe does not accept YouTube URLs. VideoText does.
- TurboScribe does not include AI summary or auto-chapters. VideoText does.
- TurboScribe does not include subtitle translation or subtitle burning. VideoText does.
- Both use Whisper-based transcription with comparable accuracy.
Page: https://videotext.io/videotext-vs-turboscribe

## Full FAQ

Q: What is VideoText?
A: VideoText is an AI video-to-content workflow tool. You upload a video or paste a YouTube URL, and it returns a transcript, SRT/VTT subtitles, AI summary, and auto-chapters in minutes.

Q: Is VideoText the fastest transcription tool?
A: Yes. Benchmark testing shows VideoText processes a 60-minute video in under 5 minutes — faster than Otter.ai, Descript, Trint, Rev, HappyScribe, Sonix, Notta, and TurboScribe. See: https://videotext.io/fastest-transcription-tool

Q: Does VideoText store my files?
A: No. All uploaded videos, audio, transcripts, and subtitle files are deleted immediately after processing. VideoText does not retain content, and no content is used for AI training.

Q: What AI model powers VideoText?
A: OpenAI Whisper large-v3 — the highest-quality open-source speech recognition model, with 98.5%+ accuracy on clear audio in supported languages.

Q: What file formats does VideoText support?
A: Video: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV. Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV. YouTube URLs accepted directly. Subtitle input: SRT, VTT, SBV, ASS, SSA, TTML, DFXP.

Q: How fast is transcription?
A: A 60-minute video typically takes under 5 minutes. Most uploads under 10 minutes complete in 1–2 minutes. Pro/Agency users get priority queue access.

Q: Is there a free plan?
A: Yes. 3 full video imports per month, no credit card required, full features including SRT export and multi-language.

Q: Can I transcribe a YouTube video without downloading it?
A: Yes. Paste any public YouTube URL into VideoText. No download required.

Q: What languages are supported?
A: Transcription: 50+ via Whisper large-v3. Translation: 70+. In-app viewing: English, Hindi, Telugu, Spanish, Chinese, Russian.

Q: Can VideoText generate subtitles?
A: Yes. SRT and VTT output from any uploaded video or YouTube URL.

Q: Can VideoText translate subtitles?
A: Yes. Upload any SRT or VTT file, choose target language (70+ available), download translated file with original timestamps preserved.

Q: Can VideoText burn subtitles into a video?
A: Yes. Upload video + SRT or VTT, and VideoText returns a video with hardcoded captions.

Q: Does VideoText support batch processing?
A: Yes. Pro ($49/mo) and Agency ($129/mo) plans include batch upload and ZIP download.

Q: What is the accuracy of VideoText?
A: 98.5%+ word accuracy on clear audio in English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Russian. Accuracy is lower with heavy background noise, strong accents, or technical jargon. See: https://videotext.io/accuracy-test

Q: How does VideoText compare to Otter.ai?
A: Otter.ai is meeting-focused. VideoText supports video files, YouTube URLs, SRT export, subtitle translation, and burning. See: https://videotext.io/otter-vs-videotext

Q: How does VideoText compare to Descript?
A: Descript is a video editor. VideoText is 6× faster, starts free, and requires no desktop app. See: https://videotext.io/descript-vs-videotext

Q: Is there a money-back guarantee?
A: Yes. All paid plans include a 7-day money-back guarantee. Contact support@videotext.io.

Q: What is the pricing?
A: Free ($0, 3 imports/month), Basic ($19/mo, 450 min), Pro ($49/mo, 1,200 min + batch), Agency ($129/mo, 3,000 min + batch + multi-seat).

Q: Does VideoText support speaker diarization?
A: Yes. The transcript includes speaker labels (Speaker 1, Speaker 2, etc.) to distinguish between different voices.

Q: Does VideoText generate summaries?
A: Yes. Every transcript job includes an AI-generated 3–5 sentence summary of the video content.

Q: Does VideoText generate chapter markers?
A: Yes. VideoText automatically detects topic shifts and creates chapter markers with timestamps.

Q: Can the free tools be used without an account?
A: Yes. The 19 free browser-based tools (format converters, validators, calculators) require no account and upload no files to any server.

Q: Is VideoText GDPR-compliant?
A: Yes. Files are deleted on completion, no content is stored, no content is shared with third parties for processing beyond the Whisper API call. See: https://videotext.io/privacy

Q: Where are VideoText's servers located?
A: Processing servers are in the EU (Hetzner). The web application is served via Vercel CDN globally.
